Florida Man's Alleged Mailbox Rampage Ends at a Hotel, With a City Trash Bin Still Stuck Under the SUV

Cape Coral police didn't need a detective. They needed to follow the bumper.

Cape Coral police say a driver in a black SUV with no license plate plowed through mailboxes, trash cans and a road sign on Country Club Boulevard on Nov. 23, then backed into a space at a nearby hotel. Officers found the SUV with part of a mailbox and a city trash bin still wedged underneath. He faces four counts of hit and run, plus drug and no-license charges.
